purpose: Preserve interim clean-series strategy-adjustment hypotheses for the next version/release review without changing frozen V2R3.

hypotheses.title: WAIT should remain a bounded watch state instead of collapsing to one late recheck then terminal REJECT
hypotheses.candidate_change: Replace one-shot TTL semantics with bounded event-near watch conditions and fresh whole-strategy recheck. Never direct-buy from a trigger.
hypotheses.validation_gate: Compare frozen V2R3 against separate V2R4 paper series; measure WAIT->trigger->fresh-recheck conversion, false triggers, timing, MFE/MAE and net costs.

hypotheses.title: Continuation/second-leg opportunities may be underweighted
hypotheses.candidate_change: Preserve good candidates after the first impulse and test continuation/second-leg confirmation separately from initial-breakout entry.
hypotheses.validation_gate: Versioned one-change comparison; do not infer entry quality from MFE alone.

hypotheses.title: Resistance/breakout caution may be too terminal
hypotheses.candidate_change: Test routing selected cases to WAIT/watch for confirmation instead of immediate idea death; do not simply remove resistance checks.
hypotheses.validation_gate: Prospective test with explicit confirmation conditions, costs and false-breakout rate.

hypotheses.title: Extended setups should not be broadly loosened; pullback/rebuild handling is safer than chase
hypotheses.candidate_change: Keep anti-chase protection; test pullback/structure rebuild/second-leg entry rather than immediate entry after extension.
hypotheses.validation_gate: MAE/MFE plus structure-aware entry simulation with realistic Kraken EUR costs.

hypotheses.title: Cost/edge objections may sometimes identify a bad current entry rather than a dead setup
hypotheses.candidate_change: Separate 'setup dead' from 'entry inefficient now'; allow bounded watch/re-entry conditions while retaining fee/spread/slippage hurdle.
hypotheses.validation_gate: Net-after-cost prospective comparison; never drop the 0.60%/side Kraken reference merely because later MFE was large.

hypotheses.title: Successor versions should use live public Kraken Spot-EUR tradability rather than legacy static blocks/private-account absence
hypotheses.candidate_change: Live Kraken AssetPairs online Spot-EUR is operational truth; missing account-private tradability must not be negative paper evidence.
hypotheses.validation_gate: Already prepared in V2R4 policy; reconfirm at final release diff and contract tests.

governance.overwrite_policy: Do not rewrite this snapshot when evidence matures. Create V2 or a final-review disposition record.
governance.next_review: V2R3 final release review after completion gate
